description: Shared quotation-grounding vectors for Python grounded_span and TypeScript locate. contract-review-eval-harness keeps this file at tests/fixtures/grounding-vectors.json and contract-eval-web at tests/grounding-vectors.json; the two copies stay byte-identical. span is the [start, end) range of the quote in the normalised source, or null when the quote is not grounded. Grounding is a plain substring search of the normalised source (docs/metrics.md in the harness), so the mid-word vectors record current behaviour, not an endorsement of it: a quote that starts or ends inside a word is grounded, and the first match wins even inside a longer word. Changing that is a scoring change for both implementations at once.
